description: Update an existing custom field for a location.

acceptedFormat.description: Accepted file formats for FILE_UPLOAD fields (e.g. ['.pdf', '.jpg'])

customFieldId.description: The custom field ID to update

isAllowCustomOption.description: Whether custom options can be added by users (LIST fields)

isMultipleFile.description: Whether multiple files can be uploaded (FILE_UPLOAD fields)

maxNumberOfFiles.description: Maximum number of files allowed (FILE_UPLOAD fields)

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed in the field

position.description: Display position / sort order of the field

textBoxListOptions.description: Array of option strings for TEXTBOX_LIST or LIST fields

name: crm_update_custom_field
